name: How does the Denver climate affect kitchen finish carpentry?

mainEntity.name: How does the Denver climate affect kitchen finish carpentry?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Denver metro area, indoor humidity drops significantly, especially during winter heating months. Wood materials such as solid hardwood trims, face frames, and plywood boxes naturally expand and contract as moisture levels fluctuate. Before finish carpentry starts in Denver or Aurora homes, raw trim and cabinets should acclimate inside the climate-controlled residence for several days. If woodwork is installed straight from a cold delivery truck, joints can pull apart or caulk lines can crack as the wood dries out. Proper acclimation and flexible, paintable sealants help prevent winter gaps.
acceptedAnswer.description: Low regional humidity causes wood to shrink, making it critical to acclimate trim and cabinetry inside the home for several days before installation to prevent joint separation.
